treatments.UNRESOLVED_RETAIN_ALL: Every exported row counts; repeated groups are reported as unresolved sensitivity
treatments.RETAIN_ALL_CONFIRMED_SUBENTRIES: Owner/evidence confirms the identical rows are separate subentries
treatments.COUNT_ONCE: Owner/evidence confirms identical rows are export duplicates; excess rows are excluded with reason

note: Decisions are keyed by value fingerprint, never by row position. No row is deleted.
